sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Tôi có thể sửa điện thoại ở đâu? is useful when the map, sign, or building layout is not giving you the final answer. It names fix my phone in a compact way, so a local can point, give a landmark, or send you to the right counter.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Keep it short: Tôi có thể sửa điện thoại ở đâu?. Show your phone screen, charger, SIM card, Wi-Fi screen, or outlet, then listen for the first useful clue: a point, floor, street, counter, or landmark.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Use this when you are already in the general area but need the final direction. It fits SIM shop, cafe, hotel lobby, airport desk, or charging moment, especially when fix my phone can be pointed to on a map, sign, booking, or nearby landmark.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Directions in Vietnam are often answered with pointing plus a few words. That is useful: watch the gesture first, then ask a follow-up if you need the street, floor, or entrance repeated.
